stable.label: scratch-organic-navigation-ci-pass
stable.note: The active scratch runtime hides environmental cells behind organic field rendering and routes organisms through terrain-aware persistent waypoints. Fresh Codehood and Foundation CI pass; deployed browser/iPhone behavior remains unverified.

active_experience.runtime: vanilla JavaScript modules + Worker + transferred OffscreenCanvas; no third-party runtime libraries
simulation_changes: cave/atmosphere/multi-fluid environment and surface ecosystem remain active
ALife goals become persistent terrain-aware surface routes rather than direct target chasing
route cost reads actual slope, water depth, root reinforcement and waterlogged-instability state
deep water and excessive slopes block routes; organisms abandon unreachable food/water goals rather than vibrating against them
look-ahead waypoints persist between replans; steering and speed ramp exponentially instead of snapping
heading changes require steering commitment and release old stance-foot contacts before the new direction gait begins
active cave environment resolution is 18-unit cells / 40 rows rather than the previous 24-unit / 30-row active runtime
environment cells remain simulation bookkeeping but are not shown as visible block tiles
cave voids render as joined organic envelopes derived from the real solid/void field
cave water and urine render as connected smooth envelopes derived from actual per-cell liquid mass
clouds render as overlapping continuous fields derived from persistent cloud water
creature draw poses interpolate authoritative physics nodes so solver corrections are less visually twitchy
approximations: navigation is a terrain-aware side-view surface route planner, not a general 2D/3D navmesh
render-pose interpolation is presentation smoothing and does not alter simulation physics
organic cave/liquid rendering smooths discrete environmental cells while the underlying environmental solver remains cellular
cave atmosphere remains 2D cellular diffusion/transport rather than gas CFD
cave water/urine remain gravity/lateral cellular transport rather than Navier-Stokes, SPH, FLIP or MPM
surface rivers/ocean remain a one-dimensional side-view shallow-water approximation
ALife remains authored drive arbitration with memory and is not learning
creature articulation remains 2D Verlet/distance constraints with authored gait actuation

scratch_alife.note: Local sensing, stomach feeding, drinking, corpse return and traversable-route locomotion pass in the fresh Codehood run.

scratch_environment.note: Cave/gas/liquid causal tests pass again under the changed active renderer/runtime.

scratch_rendering.contract: environment grid is hidden; cave/liquid/cloud envelopes are derived from simulation fields

failed_nav_render_proofs.reason: old gait test wrote retired direct target field instead of persistent navigation goal
old planted-foot contacts could pull a turning crawler backward; turn now releases stance contacts
thirst test expected immediate targetX to equal final water goal even while turn-safe routing holds an intermediate target
gait test hard-coded a rightward destination that generated terrain legitimately marked unreachable
steering dead-zone reset the first smoothed turn increment to zero every frame; fixed so turns accumulate

legacy_ecosystem_stack.note: Previous V100-V110 and patch layers remain in repository files/history but are not imported by the current route.

active_objective: Exercise the deployed organic-render/navigation build on iPhone and judge whether cave/liquid presentation no longer reads as blocks and whether organism travel/turning is visibly less janky.
next_gate: LIVE_TESTED and DEVICE_TESTED require actual deployed browser/iPhone execution after this change. CI_PASS alone is not sufficient.
invariants: Active route must not import archived V100-V110 layers
No third-party runtime libraries in the scratch engine
Rendering must run through transferred OffscreenCanvas in a worker
Simulation cells may not be presented as visible block tiles in the default renderer
Do not call the side-view planner a general 2D/3D navmesh
Do not call render interpolation physics
Do not call cellular gas transport CFD
Do not call the ALife controller learning
CI_PASS does not imply LIVE_TESTED or DEVICE_TESTED
